==History==
Blue Dart was founded by [[Tushar Jani]] ([[chairman]]) and his friends Khushroo Dubash and Clyde Cooper in November 1983.<ref>{{cite web |author= |title=COMPANY PROFILE |url=https://www.nseprimeir.com/z_BlueDart/comprofile.aspx?value=O13MyQclQQPM600MSHCcMw== |url-status=live |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160817153249/http://www.nseprimeir.com/z_BlueDart/comprofile.aspx?value=O13MyQclQQPM600MSHCcMw== |archivedate=2016-08-17 |website=nseprimeir.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |author= |title=FFFAI Hall Of Fame |url=https://www.fffai.org/fffai-hall-of-fame.php |url-status=live |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20161020232540/http://fffai.org/fffai-hall-of-fame.php |archivedate=2016-10-20 |website=fffai.org}}</ref> In its early years, Blue Dart had a business agreement with Gelco Express International, UK, for the operations of international air package express services from India.<ref>{{cite web |author= |title=EA RESEARCH EXECUTIVE VIEW ANIL KHANNA |url=http://www.executiveaccess.co.in/ea_research_access_anil_khanna/ |url-status=live |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170110231745/http://www.executiveaccess.co.in/ea_research_access_anil_khanna/ |archivedate=2017-01-10 |website=executiveaccess.co.in}}</ref>

In 2010–11, it introduced ′[[cash on delivery|cash on delivery (COD)]]′ to its customers as an additional payment option for its courier services.

Blue Dart is handling almost 8% of India's e-commerce shipments as of 2024. It opened the India's largest, low emission 2.5 lakh sq ft integrated logistics center at Bijwasan, [[Delhi]] on January 14, 2025, to improve land and air connections in [[northern India]]. The facility can easily integrate with the [[PM Gati Shakti]] due to its immediate connectivity to the [[Indira Gandhi International Airport]], [[Indian Railways]], metro lines, and national highways. Every day, the integrated logistics hub can handle 550,000 inbound and outbound shipments.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Patel |first=Deepak |date=14 January 2025 |title=Aim to have 25% share in Indian e-com cargo market: DHL E-commerce CEO |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/aim-to-have-25-share-in-indian-e-com-cargo-market-dhl-e-commerce-ceo-125011401037_1.html |access-date=15 January 2025 |work=Business Standard}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-01-14 |title=Blue Dart launches integrated logistics hub in Delhi |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/retail/blue-dart-launches-integrated-logistics-hub-in-delhi/articleshow/117241911.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-01-15 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref>

extract: Blue Dart Express is an Indian logistics company that provides courier delivery services. It is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It has a subsidiary cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation that operates in South Asian countries. In 2002, Blue Dart had a business alliance with DHL Express and on 8 November 2004, DHL Express invested €120 million in it, and since then has been a major shareholder in the company.
